title: CAPA: Manufacturing Carbon Estimation for Advanced-Packaged Architectures
artifact_scope: CAPA artifact-evaluation bundle with Python scripts, architecture descriptions, parameters, and reference figures.

run.environment: Python 3 with numpy, scipy, and matplotlib available

cross_case_observation: The two MI300X parameterizations execute successfully and differ materially in modeled total carbon; this demonstrates sensitivity to artifact inputs, not an independently established product comparison.
interpretation: The documented TPUv4 artifact case reproduced and generated the expected CSV output. This verifies bounded artifact execution only; it does not validate the paper's model assumptions, manufacturing data, comparative conclusions, or independent scientific correctness.
next_action: Capture the manuscript's exact model scope and compare additional architecture cases under a pinned environment before any headline carbon claim is accepted.
